"""Split a sequence into consecutive fixed-size chunks."""


def chunks(items, size):
    """Return a list of consecutive lists of length ``size``.

    The last chunk may be shorter. ``size`` must be a positive int;
    bools, non-integers and non-positive values raise ValueError.
    Empty input returns [].
    """
    if isinstance(size, bool) or not isinstance(size, int) or size <= 0:
        raise ValueError("size must be a positive integer, got %r" % (size,))
    seq = list(items)
    return [seq[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(seq), size)]
